name: Hubstaff
summary: Time tracking with screenshots, activity levels, GPS and payroll integration for distributed teams.
best_for: agencies and distributed teams that bill clients for hours and need defensible time records — the proof is the product, and per-seat is fair when every seat is a person you invoice for
skip_if: you want to know whether your team is working — that is a management problem and surveillance software makes it worse; also skip it if seats churn a lot, since you pay for every seat you forget to remove
honest_knock: The seat definition is the whole story and they state it plainly, which deserves credit: you pay for every seat you have created, not every person actually being tracked. So an account that grew with your headcount and never got tidied up is billing you for people who left. Audit your seat list before renewal, not after. The second thing is that features on the lower tiers are add-ons rather than inclusions — Insights, Tasks, Silent app and extra screenshots at $2.50 a seat a month, Locations at $3.33 — so the plan you priced and the plan that does what you watched in the demo may differ by ten dollars a seat. And be clear with yourself about why you are buying it: screenshots and activity levels change how a team feels about their work, and that cost does not appear on any pricing page.

pricing.notes: (2026-08-29, read on their own pricing page) Priced per seat, with both billing columns published. Billed annually: Starter $4.99, Grow $7.50, Team $10, Enterprise $25 per seat per month. Billed monthly: Starter $7, Grow $9, Team $12; Enterprise is sold annually only. The annual column is labelled 'Annual (2 months free)'. Starter, Grow and Team each carry a 2 seat minimum, so the smallest bill Hubstaff will issue is $9.98 a month rather than $4.99. Their FAQ is explicit about what a seat means: 'Hubstaff charges per seat. This means that even if only two out of your three team members are using its tracking features, you will still have to pay for all three members.' Seats added mid-term on an annual plan are prorated — their example is $60 for a seat added in July on a January-to-December plan. Six add-ons are sold per seat per month: Insights, More screenshots, Tasks and Silent app from $2.50, Locations from $3.33, Data retention from $1.67. VIP Support is $29 a month per organisation for accounts spending $275-$400 a month and $59 above $400. There is a 14-day free trial with no credit card, a 30-day money-back guarantee excluding that trial, and a free Project Viewer role for people who only read reports. Re-verified 2026-09-19, reading the plan cards as they render rather than as they ship: every figure above is unchanged — $4.99/$7.50/$10/$25 annual against $7/$9/$12 monthly, the two-seat minimum on the first three tiers, Enterprise annual-only, the six add-on rates, and VIP Support at $29 and $59 per organisation. Two details are worth having: Tasks is included from Grow upward and Locations is not available at all on Starter or Grow, so the add-on menu differs per tier rather than simply costing the same everywhere. The page's plan data still carries a dormant Free tier that does not render as a card and that the FAQ does not acknowledge — asked whether you can use Hubstaff for free, it answers with the 14-day trial.

exit_test.awkward: The website promises a card-free trial, but both Essentials and Grow trial-start dialogs required a payment method and described automatic annual charging after fourteen days. We cancelled both. Grow pricing said four seats minimum while checkout said two. The desktop tracker, including activity logging and screenshots, was preselected in onboarding; we deselected it and installed no app.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 31 October 2026: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We set up an organisation and stopped at the start of the trial because it asked for a card.
findings: The site says 'Free 14-day trial · No credit card required'. In the app the trial only started with a card and automatic yearly billing afterwards.
The setup has the desktop app preselected for time tracking, with screenshots and URL logging; we chose the mobile app.
Team invitations default to the Manager role.
Essentials was $3.99 per seat a month for 3 seats, billed yearly ($143.63). The Grow plan card said 4 seats minimum; its checkout said 2.
We did not enter a card, so we could not test time tracking.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
